chunks.section: Handling Common Prospect Objections › What happens if I'm not satisfied with the shortlist presented?
chunks.text:
"What happens if I'm not satisfied with the shortlist presented?"
Response: Nexova offers one additional round of search at no cost if none
of the candidates in the initial shortlist are acceptable, provided the
client has given specific feedback on why they didn't fit.

If, 4 weeks into an executive search, no qualified candidate has been
presented, the assigned consultant must escalate the case to Javier Almeida
(Operations Manager) and proactively notify the client with an action plan.

output.answer:
That's a great question, and it's something we've built into our process to protect your investment.

If none of the candidates in the initial shortlist are acceptable, Nexova will conduct **one additional round of search at no cost**. The only thing we ask is that you provide specific feedback on why those candidates didn't fit, so we can refine our search criteria and come back with a stronger, more aligned slate.

We also have a service-level commitment in place: if 4 weeks into an executive search no qualified candidate has been presented, the case is automatically escalated to our Operations Manager, Javier Almeida, who will proactively contact you with a clear action plan to get things back on track.

Does that address your concern? If so, I'd suggest we set a time to review the specific requirements for this role so we can get the search started.

Source: objection-handling / Hiring Process SLA
